_why: One table, two readers. normalisePhone lives in nala-shared.js for the page and again in worker/send-invites.js for the send, because a Worker cannot import from the site. Two copies of one rule is the thing that goes stale, so inv_suite.py and invites-test.mjs both assert against THIS file rather than against their own idea of the rule. A case added here fails whichever copy has not learned it.
cases: the common case: a guest typed spaces
brackets and hyphens are punctuation, not digits
the plus was lost somewhere; give it back
a Sydney landline: not a mobile, do not guess
an international number: do not guess at the country
one digit short of a mobile
bare words, as GuestTouch once sent
an extension is not part of a mobile number
